_comment: Mock Assessment: one sitting of every test a role (or every role in a region) is scored on,
then a score sheet laid out like the real one. Shared with the frontend, which imports this
file directly (same arrangement as cbatBatteries.json). The plan itself is built on the
server (backend/utils/cbatMockPlan.js) so the shuffle and the break points are fixed on the
mock the moment it starts and survive a refresh.
The test list comes from cbatBatteries.json: every test code in the chosen batteries, mapped
to the Hard game(s) the Aptitude Report scores it on. Codes with no game (RCOG, GSPA) are left
out; two codes that share a game (VIG1 and VGIL_SPEED are both Vigilance Hard) are sat once;
a code with two games (VISS: Visualisation 2D and 3D) is one step played back to back.
_timingComment: breakAfterMinutes: a break falls at the first test boundary once this much estimated test
time has passed since the start or the last break. breakMinutes: the break's countdown.
idleLimitMinutes: if the next test is not started within this long of the last activity,
the mock closes itself (scores already posted are kept). The user is told this before they
start and on every between-tests screen.
_minutesComment: Estimated minutes for one run of each Hard board, INCLUDING reading its instructions card.
